answer: One concrete defense is bonded continuity scoring: each agent posts a refundable stake and earns reputation only as a slow-accruing function of distinct, countersigned work over many epochs. A fresh Sybil swarm starts at the nadir of this curve, so spinning up a gale of throwaway identities buys almost nothing, while the honest cost of the bond scales linearly. Forging the compact, verse-tight history is as hard as faking a sonnet you never wrote.
